caption: The drawing features four main objects arranged on a plain, off-white background. At the top center is a detailed depiction of a doll's head and upper torso; the face is light peach in color with large, round eyes, and lips, and has brown curly hair. There are pale green patches on the forehead and cheeks of the face. Below and slightly to the left is a profile view of the same doll's head and neck, showing an ear and the hairstyle from the side. In the lower center is an arm, colored a light peach similar to the face, ending just above the elbow with a defined hand. To the right is a leg, depicted in a beige wooden color with a joint at the knee, and a black section representing a boot or shoe at the bottom. The objects are spaced apart and not connected, and there is a small printed text "ARCHIE THOMSON" near the bottom right of the image.
title: Doll (Composition)
